description: The tasks (acts, "מטלות") that concern the user, across their rikmas or in one: handed to them, open to a role they hold (or to anyone in the rikma), waiting for them to validate, or under way. Each row says what it waits on from them (nextStep: approve | claim | do | validate). Use it for "is there a new task for me", "what should I work on". Then getTaskContextTool for the one the user picks. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#listMyTasksTool

include.description: "mine" (default): only tasks that wait on the user. "all": also ones they follow, and finished ones.

name: listMyTasksTool
